The accelerated approval is based on a prespecified interim analysis of the ongoing ORIGIN Phase 3 trial (ORIGIN 3) in which participants treated with TRUTAKNA achieved a 46% reduction in proteinuria from baseline, with a statistically significant and clinically meaningful 42% reduction compared to placebo (p < 0.0001) at 36 weeks.
